Municipal2002 central sources are elected mayor lists only. Municipal2006/2010 central sources have full mayor results but no full councillor roster. Municipal2014 full council votes cover selected IVIS municipalities; other municipalities supply winners only.

Municipal2018 full IVIS result/candidate lists omit age; official local original rosters were joined only with exact electoral district+ballot row.
